messages:
Priya Rao: Heads-up: Legal signed off on the public deprecation window (30 days). We need a short runbook for docs + infra for the announcement + rollback plan. Can volunteers own runbook sections?
Ethan Brooks: I'll draft the runbook skeleton. Will include: announcement copy, PR checklist, redirects matrix, and rollback steps.
Nora Velez: I'll take the SDK examples and the migration FAQ. Plan to add both a minimal and a granular migration path. ETA: Tue morning.
Ming Zhao: I'll coordinate with infra for redirects and short TTL cache config. Infra-Bot: Note: Redirect service supports 302 and 410. We recommend 302 for the first 90 days.
Priya Rao: Good — call out anchor list for docs anchors that change. Nora, can you add a short note about embed vector dim change (embed-256 -> embed-512) and sample conversion script?
Nora Velez: Yep. Adding a snippet and a compatibility shim suggestion. Snippet (python):
```python
# quick pad/trim helper for existing vectors
def normalize_vector(vec, target_dim=512):
    if len(vec) < target_dim:
        return vec + [0.0] * (target_dim - len(vec))
    return vec[:target_dim]
```
Ethan Brooks: Add a line in runbook: "If embed dim mismatch detected in downstream, add backward-compat alias 'embed-256-compat' that auto-pads".
Legal-Team: Please include the exact deprecation wording: "After 2025-04-20 deprecated endpoints will return HTTP 410 with migration link." Use the legal-approved paragraph in the runbook.
Priya Rao: Noted. Also include a short monitoring recipe: token-error-rate > 0.5% for 15m triggers rollback. Add contact list for on-call.
Ming Zhao: For redirects, infra wants a CSV with: old_path, new_path, reason, owner. I'll paste a template in the PR.
Docs-Bot: Reminder: add labels 'deprecation' and 'urgent' to all related PRs. Attach test plan.
Ethan Brooks: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/418. It has runbook.md + redirects-template.csv. Feedback welcome.
Nora Velez: Quick note on SDK param rename: v1 used 'api_key' header, v2 uses 'authorization: Bearer <token>'. I'll put explicit curl and SDK side-by-side examples. Example curl: 
```bash
# v1
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: ApiKey $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
# v2
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"hi"}'
```
Priya Rao: Nice. Also add a short line about streaming framing changes (preface and JSONL differences).
Nora Velez: Will do — adding small diff table and example for Node streaming consumer.
Ming Zhao: Infra will enact 302 redirects on merge, then switch to 410 at deprecation date. I will schedule the switch with ops-proc.
Ethan Brooks: Can someone add a short rollback command in runbook? e.g., revert docs deploy + flip redirect back to v1 endpoints.
Priya Rao: I'll add the exact rollback steps and who to ping. Also adding a preflight checklist: smoke tests, redirect verification, snippet lint, and legal signoff.
Docs-Bot: Meeting scheduled: #docs-review Thurs 11:00 PT for final go/no-go. :white_check_mark:
Priya Rao: Thanks team. If any snippet owners need help, ping me. We'll gate the announcement on successful smoke passes.
Infra-Bot: Deploy hook: docs-site deploy will run on merge. Auto-notify #prod-alerts if any redirects fail (>=3 5xx responses).
